description: Dated list of a lease's notice deadlines and option windows, from its expiration date and options: each renewal option's notice deadline or notice window and renewal term (successive options count back from the term before), each termination option's last day to give notice, an expansion option deadline, and other deadlines (a stated date, or N days after a date such as a ROFO notice). Calendar months; N months before a date keeps the day of month, clamped to a shorter month's end (a warning gives the month-end reading when it is later). Deadlines on a weekend or US federal holiday (5 U.S.C. §6103, observed days included) are flagged, or rolled to the preceding or following business day when business_day_roll says so. With as_of: days to each event, passed deadlines warned, and the next deadline. Steps show each computation. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.critical_dates@1, every step, and any warnings.

as_of.description: Date to measure from (YYYY-MM-DD), usually today. Deadlines before it are flagged as passed; next_deadline is the first one on or after it.

business_day_roll.description: What to do with a deadline that falls on a weekend or holiday: "none" (default) keeps the date and flags it; "preceding" moves it to the business day before (never later than the lease date: the safe choice); "following" moves it to the next business day, which only a lease clause that says so allows.

commencement_date.description: Commencement date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; listed as an event and checked to be before expiration_date.

expansion_option_deadline.description: Last day to exercise an expansion option (lease.expansion_option_deadline), YYYY-MM-DD.

expiration_date.description: Expiration date of the current term (YYYY-MM-DD), as the lease or the latest amendment states it.

holidays.description: Holidays that are not business days: "us_federal" (the eleven US federal holidays of 5 U.S.C. §6103(a), with the federal observed day when one falls on a weekend) or "none" (weekends only).

other_deadlines.description: Other deadlines: expansion rights, ROFO or ROFR response periods, contraction rights.

date.description: The deadline, when the lease states the date.

from_date.description: Or the date it counts from (e.g. the day Landlord's ROFO notice was received), with days_after.

label.description: What the deadline is, e.g. "ROFO response for Suite 410".

renewal_option.description: Renewal options, as lease.renewal_option states them: each is exercised by notice counted back from the expiration in effect when it is exercised.

notice_days.description: Notice "no later than N days before" the date it counts back from, in calendar days.

notice_months.description: Notice "no later than N months before" the date it counts back from, in calendar months.

notice_window.description: A notice window ("not earlier than 18 nor later than 12 months before expiration"), instead of notice_months or notice_days.

earliest_months_before.description: The window opens this many calendar months before the expiration in effect (notice given earlier is premature).

latest_months_before.description: The window closes this many calendar months before the expiration in effect (the last day to give notice).

term_months.description: Length of each renewal term in calendar months.

termination_options.description: Early termination options, as lease.termination_option states them; notice counts back from each effective_date.

effective_date.description: Date the early termination takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD).

label.description: Name for this option, e.g. "Year 5 termination right".

notice_days.description: Notice "no later than N days before" the date it counts back from, in calendar days.

notice_months.description: Notice "no later than N months before" the date it counts back from, in calendar months.
